judgment.rationale: The author clarified the symptom in English, but the report still lacks the exact Keyboard Manager mapping, WeChat version, affected input context, and evidence that the behavior is reproducible outside WeChat. The issue is plausible but insufficiently specified for a design judgment.
evidence: The body reports PowerToys 0.100.2 with Ctrl and Alt swapped in Keyboard Manager.
The original description says double-clicking in WeChat closes the WeChat window.
The author later clarified in English that the window closes instead of performing a normal double-click.
The issue remains labeled Needs-Triage and Needs-Team-Response with no assignee.
No bug report, mapping screenshot, WeChat version, or comparison with other applications is provided.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact mapping configuration, application versions, and a comparison test in another application.

comment.body:
Thanks for clarifying the symptom. Please provide the following so the behavior can be reproduced:

- A screenshot or export of the exact Keyboard Manager remappings, including whether the swap is configured as Ctrl-to-Alt and Alt-to-Ctrl or through another mapping.
- The WeChat version and whether this occurs in the desktop client, a specific window, or all WeChat windows.
- Whether double-clicking the title bar, message area, and another control produces the same result.
- Whether the same Ctrl/Alt mapping causes an unintended close in another application such as Notepad or File Explorer.
- Whether the problem remains after disabling every other Keyboard Manager mapping and restarting PowerToys.
- A fresh bug report ZIP captured after reproducing the issue.
